source: European Tree of the Year, https://www.treeoftheyear.org/previous-years/{year}, finalists 2011 to 2026
note: A NOMINATION LIST, not a register and not an import (data/toty-contests.json). Facts only, read off each nominee's own contest page: name, the region line, the species and age as the contest states them, the published GPS, year, rank and result. No story text and no photographs were taken: contest photographs belong to their entrants and are not a photo source under hard rule 4. Every lead still needs two independent sources, a living-tree check and hard rule 10 before it may ship. status 'published' means we already map it (mapped_as, with how that was decided); 'blocked' means it must never ship; 'lead' is open. species is the contest's own wording and is not yet normalised to our canonical common names (hard rule 9).
